entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnetup init` installs out-of-date versions that `dotnetup update` immediately replaces #57126
  • `dotnet watch --no-hot-reload`: target framework prompt doesn't respond to keys #57125
  • `dotnet watch -c Release` on a web app crashes with `KeyNotFoundException` for event id 1021 #57123
  • File based program newer finishes in DotNet 11, but does in DotNet 10 #57121
  • [11.0 regression] dotnet test error: No devices are available for this project #57120
  • Release-property discovery evaluates shared projects and prints missing CodeSharing imports #57116

Closed

  • dotnet restore --getProperty:ProjectAssetsFile returns an empty string for multi targeted projects #49426

PullRequests

Created

  • Move managed build container to Azure Linux 4.0 #57124
  • Require sdk_dir in the Native AOT bridge #57119
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57118
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Skip shared projects in release property discovery #57117
  • Kill Windows watch process descendants during forced termination #57113

Merged

  • [wasm] Migrate BlazorWebAssembly tests to CoreCLR #56461
  • [wasm] Restore Crossgen2 for CoreCLR browser publish defaults #57099
  • Make ProjectAssetsFile available in cross-targeting builds #57006
